pointerRules: 不得用later current Result替换历史引用

semanticRules: ordinal从0连续且恰等于Fact row的`source_ref_count`，`source_order=ordinal`，全部Work/Attempt/Plan/Event必须构成同一Run、同一Execution Basis
`result_schema_ref`逐字节复制对应Capability manifest的result contract ref（该contract必须以`$ref`唯一指向下述领域typed Result），领域payload自己的`schemaRef`再独立逐字节校验
所有`result_digest`都逐字节复制对应`fx_event_result_bindings.result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(包含领域内digest字段的完整typed Result))`，不得复制Result内部排除自身计算的领域摘要
`input_binding_digest=SHA-256(JCS(fx_plan_nodes.input_bindings_json解析后的完整typed value))`。`decision_evidence`恰包含Product Identity Event的Decision Evidence实际引用的有界Query Result链

Movie固定为一项`libra.routing.fact.observe@1 → RoutingFactObservation@1`且只接受唯一`resolved_provider_identity` Fact，`source_ref`固定为Decision Evidence ID，Evidence列复制该Observation的Evidence ID/payload digest，且Query Result、Decision Evidence、Resolved Identity、Source Basis和同Run Subject必须一致
`libra.product_identity.resolve@1`在同一`domain_fact_commit` Event内原子形成Resolved Identity、Subject identity revision、Product Fact、Source refs、Result与marker，不允许先发布无Owner Fact的游离Resolution Result

`western_analysis`固定一至16项`libra.western.analysis.observe@1 → WesternAnalysisResult@1`后恰一项`libra.western.metadata.normalize@1 → ProductMetadataDraft@1`，observe的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisResult.resultArtifactHandle.artifactHandleId`且该Handle/digest逐字节命中同Run Artifact Registry row，Evidence列非NULL
normalize Plan input必须显式引用前序Result且最后Result逐字节等于Commit Draft

`western_match`恰一项`shared.face.reference.match@1 → PersonMatchEvidence@1`且`source_ref=PersonMatchEvidence.evidenceId`、Evidence列非NULL，其matches可为空但必须来自真实Frame→Embedding→Cluster→Match链。`reference_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-fact-source-ref@1",productFactId,ordinal,sourceBasisKind,workId,attemptId,planId,eventId,resultId,capabilityRef,resultSchemaRef,resultDigest,sourceRef,sourceOrder,evidenceId,evidenceDigest,inputBindingDigest}))`
relation存在期间所指Foundation链及Western Artifact Registry row不得GC
不得用later current Result替换历史引用
